title: Sarepta Therapeutics
summary: US biotech focused on Duchenne muscular dystrophy gene therapies.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Sarepta sells exon-skipping medicines for Duchenne muscular dystrophy and launched a gene therapy for the disease. Its franchise targets a small patient population with high prices, and safety events have drawn regulatory scrutiny. Manufacturing and label expansion are the key variables.

Technology Exposure

  • Exon-skipping therapies
  • Duchenne gene therapy
  • Rare-disease pipeline

What To Watch

  • Gene-therapy safety and labelling
  • Payer access
  • Manufacturing

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
